raw_title: Happiness in Political Communication by Men and Women Members of the US Congress
title_en: Happiness in Political Communication by Men and Women Members of the US Congress
title_zh: Happiness in Political Communication by Men and Women Members of the US Congress
plain_summary_en: This paper studies Happiness in Political Communication by Men and Women Members of the US Congress. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Happiness, Political, Men, And. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
